question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **exacerbate.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of the given words.

 
 
• **Mitigate**: To make something less severe or less unpleasant. (कम करना)
 
• **Effectuate**: To do something or make something happen. (सिद्ध करना)
 
• **Exacerbate**: To make a situation more violent, bitter, or severe. (किसी स्थिति को अधिक हिंसक, कड़वा या गंभीर बनाना)
 
• **Alleviate**: To make less hard to bear; lighten or relieve pain, suffering, etc. (सहन करने के लिए कम कठिन बनाना; दर्द, पीड़ा आदि को हल्का या दूर करना)
 
 
 
• So, as per the meaning of the given words "**Exacerbate**" is the most appropriate option.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: These four platforms have a detrimental impact because they can make bullying, sleep issues, anxiety, despair, and loneliness worse in children and young people.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

 

Complete passage: *Four of the most popular forms i.e. Facebook, Twitter, Snapchat, and Instagram of social media (1) inflict__ great damage to young people’s mental health. These four platforms have a negative effect because they can **__(2) __*****__exacerbate__** *children’s and young people’s body image worries, and worsen bullying, sleep problems, anxiety, depression, and loneliness. The findings follow growing (3) _________ among politicians, health bodies, doctors, and parents about young people suffering harm as a result of cyberbullying and social media (4)_________ feelings of self-loathing and leading them to commit suicide. However, the leader of the UK’s psychiatrists said these findings were too simplistic and they (5)________ blamed social media for the complex reasons why the mental health of so many young people is suffering.*

44:Tfa1,

The correct answer is: **concern.**
